paper_title: Axion Dark Matter from Cosmic String Network
notes: This is a lattice simulation paper deriving a lower bound on the QCD axion mass from cosmic string network axion dark matter production. While it does derive a lower bound on the axion mass (using Omega_a h2 <= 0.12 with the reference 0.12*(28 ueV/m_a)^7/6), the paper text provided does not give an explicit final numerical value of the axion mass lower bound in the excerpt. This is not a coupling-vs-mass exclusion curve of the standard haloscope/laboratory type; it is a cosmological abundance bound on m_a. No extractable (mass, coupling) data points are present. The reference scaling relation Omega_a h2 ~ 0.12 (28 ueV/m_a)^7/6 is quoted but the derived numerical lower bound value is not in the provided text.
